en-US.description: Lightweight, cloud-native GIS platform for visualizing and analyzing geospatial data
en-US.longDescription:
GeoLibre is a lightweight, cloud-native desktop GIS for visualizing and
analyzing geospatial data, built on MapLibre with deck.gl for 3D and
point-cloud overlays. It loads vector and raster files, web services, 3D
Tiles, MBTiles, and cloud-native formats, and is extensible through a plugin
ecosystem.
en-US.name: GeoLibre Desktop
en-US.releaseNotes:
GeoLibre v3.6.1 sets the map CRS from a link or a plugin, makes the OSM Downloader more reliable, and gives plugins and AI clients more to work with. It also repairs the desktop sidecar for people whose machines offered it Python 3.15, and fixes the Python widget's layout. It brings together 9 pull requests from 5 contributors, 2 of them contributing for the first time. Thank you to everyone who helped!

## Highlights

• **Map CRS from a link or a plugin**：a `?crs=` parameter such as `?crs=EPSG:25832` or `?crs=earth-arctic` opens the map in that CRS, so a shared map that relies on a WMS offered only in a national system no longer opens blank on Web Mercator. Plugins can do the same with `app.setMapCrs()`. See [Embedding](https://geolibre.app/user-guide/embedding/).
• **A more reliable OSM Downloader**：the area limit is checked before any request is sent, requests fall back across Overpass relays and to the OSM map API for small extents, and a persistent preview leads to direct GeoJSON or GeoParquet export. See [Plugins](https://geolibre.app/user-guide/plugins/).
• **Live desktop control over MCP**：new `live_*` tools let an AI client read and move the camera, add markers, query layer, selected, drawn, and rendered features, toggle identify and built-in controls, run Whitebox tools and Model Builder graphs, and capture a snapshot of an open desktop window. See [MCP server](https://geolibre.app/mcp/).
• **More for plugins**：plugins can register file handlers that claim files dropped on the map, including telling zip archives apart by their contents, write files into a folder the user picked, and export GeoJSON and GeoParquet through the host. See the [Plugin API](https://geolibre.app/plugin-api/).
• **Fixes**：the desktop sidecar and Jupyter environments are pinned to Python 3.12, so the sidecar no longer fails to start when uv picks Python 3.15, and affected installs repair themselves. In the Python package, `Map.layout` is the regular ipywidgets `Layout` again and the app layout preset moves to `app_layout=`; `Map(layout="full")` still works with a deprecation warning. See [Python](https://geolibre.app/python/).

## Download

Launch GeoLibre Web at https://web.geolibre.app, or get the desktop and mobile apps from https://geolibre.app/downloads/ (or the assets below).
